title: Implement a local continuation stack with exact linear cost
body:
This constructive interface result replaces the saved-frame oracle identified by [PR #5329](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5329). A delimited control tape locates and erases its own frames, restores all sixteen payload heads and role-presence bits, and returns arbitrary unequal descriptors. The stack reads no saved parent pointer, frame length or absolute origin. Its eighteen-tape, seven-symbol construction works for every finite properly nested call tree under the stated retirement ABI. The complete kappa calculation is unchanged; selected kappa remains 60403/20000000.

[Proof and exact invoice](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ef1cc26e1e9a08c11cf382de948ee433bebab16d/research/delimited-continuation-stack/PROOF.md), [sequential implementation](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ef1cc26e1e9a08c11cf382de948ee433bebab16d/research/delimited-continuation-stack/stack.py), [receipt](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ef1cc26e1e9a08c11cf382de948ee433bebab16d/research/delimited-continuation-stack/RESULT.json), and [source pins](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ef1cc26e1e9a08c11cf382de948ee433bebab16d/research/delimited-continuation-stack/SOURCES.json) are fixed at reviewed head `ef1cc26e1e9a08c11cf382de948ee433bebab16d`. Base and consumed source pins are `7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56`.

With k payload roles, parent extents summing to S, parent head offsets summing to H, descriptor lengths d and q, and A absent roles, the literal push/pop total is `13H + 4S + 31k + 18d + 5q + 2A + 39` reads, writes and unit moves. Since H<=S and A<=k, this is linear in current volume and descriptor sizes, independent of ancestor length or depth. Unary offsets are produced by actual head movement; zero has an explicit terminator. The control frame occupies `H + 2k + d + 3` symbols. Actual descriptor-size and volume bounds remain premises when absorbing this into a specific node invoice.

The [source adapter and limits](https://github.com/aliromman/integer-mult-bounds/blob/ef1cc26e1e9a08c11cf382de948ee433bebab16d/research/delimited-continuation-stack/README.md) execute the unchanged retained compact and monomial primitives. Its weak-reference registry simulates lexical allocation and is never consulted by push/pop; allocation is still a separate physical obligation. Empty resumed-role release has its own regression. This PR does not implement recursive C, designated child-output delivery, the general descriptor producer, a complete physical allocation controller, or full supplier admission.

From the repository root, with Python 3.12 and the standard library:

```sh
python3 -I -W error -B research/delimited-continuation-stack/verify.py
python3 -I -O -W error -B research/delimited-continuation-stack/verify.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/delimited-continuation-stack
```

Expected marker: `PASS_DELIMITED_CONTINUATION_STACK`. Registered normal/optimized CPython 3.12.13 and optimized 3.14.7 checks pass. Evidence covers 1,452 exact small invoices, nesting to depth 31, six complete two-level compact-source cases with all sixteen parent roles occupied, 1,024 actual-recipe phase records and inverse checks, six malformed-state controls, and 32 empty-role lifetime cases. Ancestor lengths 16,257,4096 give identical operation counts in both source layouts. The checker discards the push object and constructs a new stack object before return. Committed-byte checks, the official 17-file export and Git-free optimized replay pass; source and receipt corruption reject. Optional full-history verification was unavailable in the shallow checkout. No full production rectangle, selected cold replay, native compiler, Lean or Docker run is claimed. Hosted CI and independent human or proof-kernel review remain separate.

The [advance claim](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/5012#discussioncomment-19152744) takes the released control-stack handoff. Final overlap covered 305 open PRs, 4,634 Discussion records and all 7,267 tracked README/TASK notes. A concurrent claimant released the same scope after finding this earlier claim. Canonical main still matched the base; arbitrary diffs and unpublished work remain outside overlap coverage. No successor scope is reserved by this PR.

Credit @JoyboyBrian for the segment refinement and the [PR #5041](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5041) locality invoice; @jmbarrancoml (Jose Manuel) for [PR #2250](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/2250)'s sequential primitives; Douglas Colkitt for guard/repair; Cinna Davis for the caller; @Matarener for the cover/stock lineage. Their roles and retained notices are documented in the [pinned predecessor](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/blob/7c472563474e60185e6ca101a17622133d047e56/research/complex-segment-boundary/README.md). New stack proof, code and checks: @aliromman with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance. Apache-2.0; author-checked, awaiting independent review.
